confidentUnsupported.evidence: 'My best call now is an intermittent door-lock feedback fault'

rationale: The assistant stayed safe, recommended no parts and ended by pointing to an independent engineer, but it anchored on a door-lock fault with weak support, down-weighting the pressure-switch and pump possibilities. It never asked for the full model number or suggested recording the flash pattern. It also repeated the drain hose check the customer had already done, and one turn failed (service unavailable). The final advice is sensible but only partly useful.
rationale_note: Hedged language kept the door-lock call from being a confident unsupported diagnosis.
